title: [review] channel.py: Priority parameter in send_message/send_datagram not propagated
description: SecureDatagramChannel.send_message() and send_datagram() accept priority param but don't propagate it. _schedule_send() and _send_protected() don't accept priority. The 3 self._inner.send_datagram() calls (lines 1274, 1304, 1376) omit priority. Fix: Add priority param to _schedule_send() and _send_protected(), pass to all inner calls.
close_reason: Fixed: Added priority param to _schedule_send, _send_protected, and 3 _inner.send_datagram calls. Also updated test fixtures to accept **kwargs.
